message.content: 分析。ret is uninitialized if macType matches a case that's #ifdef'd out but default doesn't catch it because switch matched none of compiled-in cases only if macType numeric value doesn't match any case label at all it hits default. Actually the bug: if src->macType corresponds to a case that IS the one macro-guarded in but here's catch: all cases assign ret via the underlying wc_XxxCopy() function returns value. Even so ret could be considered "uninitialized" if compiler flags it since default returns early, but for matched case, wc_XxxCopy sets ret. So actual bug must be that one of those wc_XxxCopy functions can return without setting the output on some path — e.g. wc_Sha3_224_Copy() might not initialize `ret` in same manner recursively, but that's a different function. Let's search fuzz target and git history/patch for this CVE to understand exact condition.
